spots.name: Cordova
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 210 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L6317329.

spots.name: Mount Chosin Few
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 2,453 m (8,048 ft).
